name: Marguerite Loy

poster.hook: Still delivering the mail. Every letter is addressed to the same house.

flashback: Whose house are the letters for, and what's in the one you haven't opened?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Marguerite sits in the waiting room sorting the same letters over and over. Use her to put a hard, kind truth in front of whoever needs it.

story.concept: A rural postwoman who kept doing her round after the dark came, because someone had to. Practical, funny, and lying about how she got here.
story.look: Royal Mail anorak, a bicycle clip still on one ankle, a sack over her shoulder heavier than letters should be, hair cut short with kitchen scissors.
story.stake: One of the letters in her sack is for this station. She hasn't decided whether to deliver it.

ties.text: He saw her at the crossing. She's told him it was someone else, and she can see he doesn't believe her.
His name and his old address are on one of her letters. He hasn't asked her about it yet.
ties.public: has his name in her sack
